'''Maneeli Tuun''', also known as '''Naturian''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] chief medic who worked on the [[Polis Massa Research Base|medical facility]] in the [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. Bulkier in appearance to his fellow [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massans]], Maneeli was also one of the few members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] with the ability to speak.

==Biography==

=== Early life and the birth of the Skywalker twins ===
{{Quote|I thought we had thought of everything. I checked and triple-checked. The memory wipes are solid. There is no record of the births. There is no record of yourself or Yoda being here. I didn't imagine they would come digging like this.|Maneeli Tuun to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="LOTJDW" />}}
Maneeli Tuun in the past had been greatly trusted by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], doing him many favours, as a result, it was a clear choice for Yoda and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to bring the dying [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to the [[Polis Massa Research Base|medical facility]] on Polis Massa<ref name="LOTJDW" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when she was about to give birth. Maneeli Tuun rushed his medical staff to work and despite the efforts of Tuun and his medics, Padmé [[Death/Legends|died]] in theater, though the Polis Massans were able to successfully deliver the [[Senator/Legends|Senator's]] children, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]].<ref name="ROTS">''[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Maneeli Tuun made certain that no record of Luke or Leia's births, or Yoda and Obi-Wan's presence remained.<ref name="LOTJDW" />

=== Protecting the twins ===
{{Quote|First, an investigator came. He never gave his name, but he copied all our records and took them back to Malorum. That was about a month ago. Now this one arrived. He's an expert on record security. He's already done an exhaustive search on the memory banks of the med droids, even the ones who weren't here during that time.|Maneeli Tuun to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="LOTJDW" />}}
Eventually [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|head Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] took a great interest in the death of Padmé,<ref name="LOTJTDM">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref><ref name="LOTJDON">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref> knowing the rumor that she was killed by a rogue Jedi was concocted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="LOTJDON" /> and so he sent [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to Polis Massa to investigate.<ref name="LOTJDW" /> Tuun never got the name of Fett, and once Fett returned to Malorum with no information-at least of significance-and so he sent an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] called [[Sancor]] to continue investigations. Sancor was deeply skilled in record security and relentlessly searched the medical records on Polis Massa, alongside the memory banks of the med droids, even the ones who were absent during Padmé's stay. Sancor requested the supply records, as he would be able to determine which supplies were used during Padmé's stay and then be able to determine if she gave birth. By that point Obi-Wan Kenobi had returned to Polis Massa,<ref name="LOTJDW" /> having rescued [[Ferus Olin]] and found out about Malorum's investigations inside Malorum's office in the Imperial Garrison on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]].<ref name="LOTJTDM" /> Tuun caught Obi-Wan up on the investigations and explained to Obi-Wan that they couldn't delete the supply files as Sancor could trace it back to him. Obi-Wan asked if adding new supplies to the files would be traceable, Tuun told him that it wouldn't, and so Obi-Wan had Tuun add more supplies to another patient who was present at the same time as Padmé and make it look like they were wanted by the Empire, though to still have the trail lead to nowhere. As a result, it would make that patient seem like a bigger prey and in turn be able to coax Sancor away from discovering Luke and Leia. Tuun downloaded the updated files to a disk before giving it to Obi-Wan and warning him to be careful as Sancor was clever, and that if they fail they would wind up executed.<ref name="LOTJDW" />

Obi-Wan disguised himself in a medical supply officer uniform with a medical mask, impersonating [[Osh Scal/Legends|Osh Scal]]. Maneeli Tuun brought Obi-Wan to Sancor, who had been waiting for fifteen minutes for Scal. Sancor rudely dismissed Tuun, as he went through the medical files with Kenobi, eventually growing suspicious enough of Kenobi to look through the employee list. Once Sancor turned away, Osh Scal's profile came up on the screen and Obi-Wan failed to mind trick him, he then suggested he could help Sancor get through the files faster by using another port. Sancor ordered for him to do so, Obi-Wan almost got away with it when Tuun poked his head in to ask if they were almost done. Sancor saw the real Osh Scal's profile, with his suspicions of something going on being confirmed. He drew his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and opened fire on Tuun, to which Obi-Wan protected Tuun with his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Sancor-who was surprised-took the disk and ran. Tuun told Obi-Wan he was running for the main hangar, and dived even before Obi-Wan told him to when Sancor used a [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rocket]]. Sancor attempted to trick Obi-Wan by hiding in the observation room of a new theatre, he attempted to use another wrist rocket to kill Kenobi, but Obi-Wan leapt out the way and leapt through the wall the wrist rocket made a hole in as the observation room fell into the theatre, causing Sancor to be killed by falling onto medical instruments below.<ref name="LOTJDW" />

Malorum eventually visited Polis Massa to discover what had happened to Sancor, and learn some information himself. Maneeli Tuun told him that Sancor had accidentally fallen from the observation platform and fell onto the medical instruments, leaving any mention of Kenobi's involvement out of it. Malorum wondered if Tuun took him for a fool. All the unrelated facts in Malorum's mind infuriated him. Eventually he looked back to how fast [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|Amidala's funeral]] was organized, thinking it was organized too hastily. He left Polis Massa for good and headed to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="LOTJDON" />
{{Char-stub}}

== Personality and traits ==
Maneeli Tuun was highly trusted by Yoda, having done many favours for Yoda in the past. Additionally, Tuun was deeply loyal to the Republic's cause and considered completely unimpeachable by Obi-Wan.<ref name="LOTJDW" />
